message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.
We were glad to see your clear offer and your interest in a long-term partnership on this shaft. Our proposal confirms a binding volume and includes an alternative package with faster payment, so you can weigh which suits you best.

We confirm a binding volume of 6000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

On this basis we propose one of these packages; please choose the one that suits you best:
- Option A: EUR 12.55 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days, delivery EXW, for our full demand of 6000 units a year over 24 months
- Option B: EUR 12.46 per unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 42 days, delivery EXW, for our full demand of 6000 units a year over 24 months

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

steps.title: Round 1 · sup:DEMO-J1 answers
steps.caption: sup:DEMO-J1 answers: open at €15.49. The belief keeps the hypotheses that predicted this reply: floor between 74.7 % and 86.4 % of its quote, patience 0.398.

message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thanks for confirming the 6000 units, that helps us plan our machines. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Our current Angebot is a price of €15.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

You asked what we need to move on price: as a small shop, faster payment helps our cash flow immensely. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. If we can agree on 14 days payment, I can drop the price to €14.90 per unit, with a price of €14.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. 

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. 

Hallo, we checked your volume forecast and cost estimate, and that lets us make another step. You switched to DAP, which means we have to organize and pay for shipping, adding to our side. Since you kept the 14 days payment, which really helps our cash flow, I can do 14.40 EUR per unit. 

Here is our offer: a price of €14.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. Please find our cost breakdown attached.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

steps.title: How HackIt Buyer works
steps.caption: Code owns every number. A belief about each supplier, narrowed by every reply, and a planner that scores candidate prices in euros - not a fixed recipe. Guards that never bend: no sheet above the alternative, no token moves, never push after a final offer, no walk-away while an acceptable sheet stands.
